- Connectable upto 100m length

Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- Warm/Cool White LED Icicle Lights
- Black or White Rubber Cable Options
- Connectable Up to 50m Length

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

## Information
This Christmas, brighten your home or garden with these enchanting multi-function cluster lights. Featuring low-power, energy-efficient LEDs arranged in clusters on a green or clear cable, they effortlessly blend into any setting. Easily switch between the 8 available functions by pressing a button on the transformer, and activate or deactivate the built-in 8-hour on 16-hour off timer function with a long press. These cluster lights create a stunning garland effect with multiple lights in close succession. The super bright, eco-friendly, low-energy LEDs are more efficient than halogen bulbs, helping you save on energy costs. Suitable for both indoor and temporary outdoor use, ensure that the transformer remains dry. This holiday season, illuminate your space with festive cheer using these delightful cluster lights.
